title: Anthropic bans ‘abusive or cruel behavior’ toward Claude
script:
Anthropic banned being mean to Claude.
The updated safety policy prohibits sustained and needless cruel behavior toward the chatbot.
It also restricts high-risk misuses like election interference and weapons development.
Would you ever bully a chatbot?
